title: Customer Feedback Thermometer and Release Prioritization Engine
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Implement a unified scoring and visibility system (the 'Thermometer') that converts multi-source customer signals into a single, time-aware priority score for roadmap intake. This ticket scopes the PM work to define scoring signals, acceptance gates, and the release-level prioritization engine used by product councils and the GTM squad for top-account escalations. The Thermometer must: 1) ingest signals from support incidents, CSM escalations, contract value, renewal risk, security requests, and executive asks; 2) apply configurable weightings and decay windows; 3) expose a playbook for automatic routing to fast-track lanes or enterprise intake with SLAs; 4) tie decisions to explicit OKR/initiative mappings and commit windows.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Priority score schema documented with source mapping and default weights in Confluence. 2. Ingest pipeline defined (events + manual intake) and mocked with synthetic data in staging. 3. UI view mockups for Thermometer card in Console and PM dashboard approved by Design. 4. Decision rules for Fast-Track / Escalation lanes and SLA handoffs documented and signed off by Legal/CSM. 5. Playbook includes roll-back/fallback paths and measurable SLOs. 6. End-to-end example flow exercised in tabletop with Sales, CSM, and Eng and resulting ticket routing validated.
success_metrics: 1) Time from escalation intake to triage decision reduced from 3d to <8h for top accounts. 2) % of top-account escalations correctly routed to Fast-Track lane >= 85%. 3) Product council time spent on low-value asks reduced by 40%. 4) Correlation between Thermometer score and quarterly renewal lift > 0.2.
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Schema + scoring rules (PM) -> small ETL proof-of-concept (Eng) -> staging dashboard (DX/Console) -> tabletop run. Phase 2: production ingestion, weight tuning, A/B validate routing, automate Slack/CSM notifications. Use existing events stream; add new 'esc_priority' field to intake events. Keep scoring computation idempotent and versioned. Store score with TTL and keep score history for audit and monthly analysis.
rollout_plan: 1) Internal pilot with three enterprise accounts for two weeks. 2) Iterate weights after pilot and run a 30-day correlation study. 3) Open Fast-Track lane to all accounts with revenue > $250k after approval. 4) Ship dashboard and Thermometer card in product council workspace. 5) Add acceptance to Dedicated & Private onboarding checklist.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overweighting single signal (e.g., security incident) causes noisy fast-tracks. Mitigation: cap per-signal contribution and add decay windows. Risk: Legal asks for audit evidence for escalations. Mitigation: store score provenance and link to original artifacts. Risk: Heavy backend load for realtime scoring. Mitigation: batch recompute for non-urgent signals and use cache for display.
notes_for_engineering: Score must be computed deterministically; include version field. Expose API: GET /api/v1/thermometer?account_id=<id>&as_of=<ts>. Add feature flag for pilot accounts. Ensure telemetry emits source counts and final score. Plan for a single small dedicated worker for scoring in Phase 1.
okrs_alignment: Objective: Improve enterprise reliability and renewal velocity. Key Result 1: Decrease time-to-triage for top accounts by 50%. Key Result 2: Increase net retention influenced by product wins +20% for pilot cohort.
customer_stories: ACME Corp escalated a data-exfiltration concern and needs a clear SLA and routing for rapid remediation and roadmap consideration.
BetaBank requests an adaptation that requires both security review and a roadmap commitment window; sales needs an objective signal for commitment.
EduTech reports repeated minor UX blockers affecting renewal conversations and wants prioritization visibility.
